entities.name: The Great Mosque of Rabat
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Great Mosque of the medina of Rabat in Morocco, also known as the el-Kharrazin Mosque, is the largest Friday mosque within the historic Andalusian medina of Rabat in Morocco. The mosque is located at the intersection of the streets of Souk Sebbat and Rue Bab Chellah.
